headline: Head of Product @ Bobyard | Scaling AI & Computer Vision Products
about:
Product leader with an engineer's foundation, currently building at the intersection of construction tech and AI.
 
I'm Head of Product at Bobyard, a construction estimating and takeoff platform, where I own product alongside GTM strategy, pricing, and growth. Since joining, we've scaled the product team significantly and grown revenue at a pace that's outstripped what most Series A companies see in a comparable window.
 
Before Bobyard, I spent my career finding the connective tissue between technical depth and product vision:
 
At Homesnap, I helped scale a B2B real estate platform, launching Agent Websites and Showings, tools that empowered agents and drove 100% YoY revenue growth.
 
At Smerf, as Lead PM, I took a gaming rewards platform from concept to App Store launch, partnering closely with Take-Two Interactive and PGA2K.
 
I then founded Eastern Oud, a vertically integrated fragrance brand, where I ran everything from international supply chains to brand strategy to e-commerce, the kind of hands-on experience that teaches you what building a business from scratch actually requires.

patents.description: A closed-loop service, referred to as an Adaptive Data Analytics Service (ADAS), characterizes the performance of a system or systems by providing information describing how users or agents are operating the system, how the system components interact, and how these respond to external influences and factors. patents.description:
Co-Inventors: Andrey Balmin, Tom Eliaz, Guy M. Lohman, David E. Simmen, Chun Zhang

An cost based optimizer optimizes access to at least a portion of hierarchically-organized documents, such as those formatted using eXtensible Markup Language (XML), by estimating a number of results produced by the access of the hierarchically-organized documents. Estimating the number of results comprises computing the cardinality of each operator executing query language expressions and further computing a sequence size of sequences of hierarchically-organized nodes produced by the query language expressions. Access to the hierarchically-organized documents is optimized using the structure of the query expression and/or path statistics involving the hierarchically-organized data. The cardinality and the sequence size are used to calculate a cost estimation for execution of alternate query execution plans. Based on the cost estimation, an optimal query execution plan is selected from among the alternate query execution plans.

Drone by Dro (DBD), founded by Pedro Silva, a certified Part 107 Unmanned Aircraft System (UAS) Operator, is a full-service provider of professional aerial and interior imaging solutions. DBD leverages advanced drone technology and specialized techniques to capture compelling visual assets for strategic marketing, data visualization, and immersive tours. Our core areas of expertise include:

Real Estate (Commercial & Residential): High-definition aerial imagery and immersive indoor drone tours to enhance property listings, showcase architectural features, and drive sales.

Construction & Infrastructure: Detailed site progress monitoring, visual documentation, and comprehensive construction project oversight.

Event Coverage: Dynamic, high-quality aerial and ground-level videography and photography for concerts, corporate functions, and other large-scale events.

Advertising & Marketing: Custom visual content creation designed to elevate brand narratives and power overall advertising campaigns.

We are dedicated to delivering exceptional service and producing outstanding results that exceed client expectations. By utilizing cutting-edge equipment and precise operational protocols, DBD ensures stunning visual output that effectively showcases products, properties, and projects.

We are actively pursuing long-term strategic partnerships across the D.C., Maryland, and Virginia (DMV) area. Contact us today to learn how our specialized imaging services can help you take your business's visual presence to new heights
